abort.auth_failed: MitID authentication failed. Please try again.
abort.missing_entry_data: Entry data for the device could not be found.
abort.already_configured: This MitID account is already set up.

error.auth_failed: MitID authentication failed. Please try again.
error.id_already_in_use: This name is already used by another Aula login. Choose another name.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Please check your credentials and try again.
error.invalid_response: Invalid response from API, please try again later.
error.account_in_use: This MitID account is already set up in another Aula login.

user.title: Log in to Aula with MitID
user.description: Aula Connect logs in to Aula with your MitID, as you do on aula.dk. You approve by scanning a QR code with the MitID app on your phone.

data_description.id: What this Aula login is called in Home Assistant, such as the family's name.
data_description.mitid_username: The user ID you log in to MitID with.

authenticate.title: Log in with MitID
authenticate.description: Approve the login by scanning the QR code with the MitID app on your phone. If no page opens, open the [MitID login]({login_path}) yourself.

auth_error.title: Login failed
auth_error.description: The MitID login failed. Select Next to try again.

reauth_username.title: MitID user ID needed
reauth_username.description: Enter the user ID you log in to MitID with, to log in to Aula again.

reconfigure.title: Change the MitID login
reconfigure.description: Change the MitID user ID. Afterwards you approve with MitID.

data_description.mitid_username: The user ID you log in to MitID with.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Aula again
reauth_confirm.description: Aula no longer accepts the login of MitID user ID {username}. Select Next, and approve with MitID.

login_expired.message: The login to Aula has expired. Log in with MitID again.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Aula Connect entry is not loaded.

method_not_read_only.message: {method} is not a method of Aula's API that only gets.

unknown_notification_area.title: Aula sends notifications Aula Connect does not know
unknown_notification_area.description: Aula sent notifications of a kind Aula Connect does not know yet: {details}. Download the diagnostics from the integration's entry and share them with the developer, so that Aula Connect can learn them. The download replaces every name, id and contact detail; read it through before sharing it.

unreadable_response.title: Aula Connect could not read an answer from Aula
unreadable_response.description: Aula Connect could not read Aula's answer to: {details}. Aula may have changed it. Download the diagnostics from the integration's entry and share them with the developer. The download replaces every name, id and contact detail; read it through before sharing it.

api_version_changed.title: Aula's API has a new version
api_version_changed.description: Aula's API is at version {details}, which Aula Connect was not made for. It may work as before; if anything is missing, download the diagnostics from the integration's entry and share them with the developer.

read.name: Read from Aula
read.description: Reads one method of Aula's API that only gets, and answers with who someone is replaced, as the diagnostics do.

config_entry_id.name: Aula account
config_entry_id.description: The Aula Connect entry to read with.

method.name: Method
method.description: The method of Aula's API, whose name starts with get after its area, such as profiles.getProfileContext.
